messages:
aisha_csops: Heads up — getting a flood of alerts from the delinquency-escalation playbook. 27 runs in the last hour that look like duplicates for accounts still in onboarding.
ben_data: I see the spike too. Started around 10:12 UTC. alert logs show webhook retries + duplicate run_ids.
tara_onboarding: Ugh. Those accounts are 'onboarding_in_progress' and we intentionally suppress escalations until onboarding_complete. Playbook should be excluding onboarding_state IN ('in_progress','pending-warmup').
diego_support: Can you drop one example account id so I can trace logs?
aisha_csops: acct_00421 is one. Raw runner log snippet: ```2026-03-23T10:12:41Z playbook.delinq.run id=run_0x1 status=queued trigger=webhook retry=1 account=acct_00421 handler=escalation```
playbook-bot: automated-run: delinquency-escalation queued=27 failures=0 avg_latency=320ms (info only)
ben_data: Looking at the rule condition — it's currently: `WHERE balance > threshold AND last_payment_at < now() - interval '30 days'` — no onboarding guard. Quick safe patch: add `AND onboarding_state NOT IN ('in_progress','trial')` and a final check `AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM playbook_runs pr WHERE pr.account = accounts.id AND pr.name = 'delinquency-escalation' AND pr.created_at > now() - interval '48 hours')` to dedupe recent runs.
tara_onboarding: That sounds right. Also please exclude accounts with `onboard_task_state = 'pending_verification'` — we've seen false positives there.
aisha_csops: Proposed immediate steps: 1) Pause new runs, 2) Push canary SQL change to filter, 3) Run backfill to cancel any duplicate queued runs, 4) Notify CS leads. I can pause: `/playbook pause delinquency-escalation --reason "dedupe-bug: pause for hotfix"`
diego_support: If paused, I'll avoid churn on the ticket queue. Ben — can you prepare the canary patch? Aim for rollback within 30m if anything odd.
ben_data: Will push canary patch to staging now. Backfill query to identify affected runs: ```SELECT pr.id FROM playbook_runs pr JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.account WHERE pr.name='delinquency-escalation' AND pr.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND a.onboarding_state IN ('in_progress','trial','pending_verification');``` I'll add `LIMIT 100` for the first pass and manually cancel.
tara_onboarding: After cancels, we should run a reconciliation to ensure no customer-facing emails were sent. If email_sent=true, we need to follow the apology playbook.
aisha_csops: Opening a runbook issue now: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CSOPS-9142 — tagging @cs-leads. Assigning: ben_data (patch + backfill), diego_support (pause/unpause + cancel ops), tara_onboarding (verify affected customers + outreach plan), me (coordinate + postmortem draft). ETA: initial mitigation in 45m.
ben_data: Canary pushed to canary host `pb-canary-03`. Running smoke tests. Will confirm in ~10m.
diego_support: Pause command executed. No new runs queued since 10:28 UTC.
aisha_csops: Thanks all. Postmortem note: root cause likely missing onboarding guard after rule refactor last deploy. We'll include a test for onboarding_state in the playbook test harness. :white_check_mark:
